news.headline: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
news.story_lead: Haley Stevens, a sitting Democratic congresswoman, appeared alongside the Republican Senate candidate on Sunday - Published 1 November 2026, 18:24 GMT A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote. Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday. "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance.
news.full_article_text: Haley Stevens, a sitting Democratic congresswoman, appeared alongside the Republican Senate candidate on Sunday - Published 1 November 2026, 18:24 GMT A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote. Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday. "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance. "Who we are as Michiganders is not hate and is not what we are getting out from our Democratic nominee right now." "That's why I am endorsing Mike Rogers," Stevens said. The move stunned many of Stevens' fellow Democrats who condemned her decision to break from the party and switch her support just two days before the election. The public feud between Stevens, a centrist Democrat, and El-Sayed, who represents the party's left-wing, has boiled over in recent days. They clashed publicly over a campaign advert from an outside liberal group which blamed Israel for high food prices. El-Sayed criticised the advert and said he had nothing to do with its contents. Stevens had been scheduled to appear at an event with El-Sayed on Sunday in an effort to display party unity, but he reportedly asked her not to come and she chose to attend a church service with his Republican opponent instead. "This is a very close election, we all know that, but Abdul made clear that I was not welcome in his campaign, that he didn't need me there, that he didn't want me there," Stevens told reporters as she stood alongside Rogers outside the church. When asked about Stevens' endorsement, El-Sayed told reporters he was focused on the problems Michiganders are facing. "At the end of the day, I don't think about Haley Stevens," he said on Sunday. "None of this matters." - GUIDE: What are the US midterms? - EXPLAINED: Why Trump's approval rating matters in the midterms - IN DEPTH: The Republicans walking a Trump tightrope The Michigan Senate race is considered by analysts to be one of the tightest in Tuesday's midterm elections. It is one of a handful of battleground contests that will ultimately decide control of the Senate. The seat is currently held by a retiring Democrat and the last time a Republican was elected to this Senate seat was in 1994. But in presidential elections, it is one of the crucial swing states - Michigan voted for Joe Biden in 2020 but Donald Trump in 2024. Rogers welcomed Stevens' endorsement and said it showed "courage" during brief remarks with reporters. President Donald Trump echoed that sentiment, saying on Truth Social that "[Stevens] showed great and almost unprecedented loyalty to the Great People of Michigan with what she did". Many of Stevens' staff reportedly resigned immediately after her announcement, while the chair of the Democratic Party in Michigan said her decision "shows that she has abandoned everything she claims to care about". "We reject the attempts by Stevens and bad-faith actors to divide our party and undermine our momentum," Curtis Hertel said in a statement. What's at stake for Trump in the US midterms? In downtown Detroit, several Democrats the BBC spoke to said they were disappointed by Stevens' endorsement of Rogers. "I just genuinely don't understand it," she said. "I do think it's a betrayal of the party because the things she stands for are not the same things that he stands for as a Republican." "Maybe she had frustrations with the party," Matthew Barera, another Michigan voter, said. Others, including Republicans who support Rogers, said they doubted it would make a difference to the race. "People can see right through her actions, you know? She's just angry," Marissa Lee, a Rogers supporter, told the BBC. "She is not going to make anybody change their mind." Over the weekend, as Stevens' criticism of El-Sayed escalated, a number of Democratic politicians in Michigan publicly encouraged her to end the feud and back the party's candidates more directly. On Sunday, Democratic Senator Chuck Schumer called Stevens' endorsement of Rogers "a despicable betrayal" of her political party. After a bruising and sometimes bitter campaign earlier this year, El-Sayed, a left-wing outsider, defeated Stevens, the establishment-backed congresswoman, to win the party's nomination for the US Senate race. The primary, and the pair's subsequent feud, has underlined divisions over the party's direction ahead of the 2028 presidential election. Former public health official El-Sayed, who is the son of Egyptian immigrants, has channelled grassroots frustration with Washington politics as well as US ties to Israel. Stevens is a more centrist Democrat - and had the support of party figures such as Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer during the primary race. news.headline: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
news.story_lead: Emergency responders at the scene of a strike on Ukraine's Vinnytsia region - Published 1 November 2026, 19:48 GMT A rare humanitarian ceasefire in Ukraine's front-line Kherson region that allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has ended. The localised ceasefire was due to end at 22:59 Ukrainian time (21:00 GMT) on Sunday. While the truce had held since it was implemented last week, fighting had continued elsewhere.
news.full_article_text: Emergency responders at the scene of a strike on Ukraine's Vinnytsia region - Published 1 November 2026, 19:48 GMT A rare humanitarian ceasefire in Ukraine's front-line Kherson region that allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has ended. The localised ceasefire was due to end at 22:59 Ukrainian time (21:00 GMT) on Sunday. While the truce had held since it was implemented last week, fighting had continued elsewhere. On Sunday evening, Ukraine's air alert system was apparently hacked, the country's air force said, warning of radiation over Kyiv - a reference to a possible nuclear attack. The Air Force message read: "The Air Alarm application has probably been subjected to hostile interference. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our channel." Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had struck energy infrastructure in four regions overnight on Saturday, leaving hundreds of thousands of homes without power. Some connections were restored on Sunday. Another overnight strike killed two people, including a 13-year-old girl, in the Vinnytsia region, the State Emergency Service of Ukraine said. Meanwhile, Ukraine hit a major missile fuel producer in Russia's Rostov region, which caused a fire and damaged four production facilities, Zelensky said. In Ukraine, repair works to restore power continued throughout the day. Most customers in the Dnipropetrovsk region had their connections restored by early evening, but more than 60,000 were still without power, the governor said. Because of regular attacks on energy infrastructure, emergency power cuts have been introduced across the country. Even in the capital Kyiv, electricity is cut off for most of the day, and water supplies are also disrupted. Zelensky said in a social media post that the intensity of Russian strikes has been "extremely high" over the past week, adding that Russia was "trying to take maximum advantage of the shortage of ballistic missile interceptors". He added that "every day" Ukraine communicated its need for Patriot missiles - the only effective weapon for downing Russia's deadly ballistic missiles - to the US, Europe and other partners. He thanked countries for their support so far and longer-term commitments, but called again for more immediate aid. Watch: Evacuees from Oleshky reunited with their families The limited pause in hostilities, which started on Tuesday, was brokered with the help of US First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo. It was originally confined to the city of Oleshky, which has been occupied by Russia since the first days of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and was expanded across the wider region of Kherson. Oleshky had been trapped on one side by the Dnipro river and the other by Russian forces, with routes out mined and subject to drone attack. Residents trapped there were suffering severe shortages of food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive. The truce allowed for Oleskhy residents to evacuate if they wanted, and there were emotional scenes on Saturday of reunions between loved ones who hadn't seen eachother for years. There are Ukrainian military positions just 5km (3.1 miles) from Oleshky, but evacuees had to travel through Russian-occupied territory to southern Russia, where they flew to Belarus, before finally being driven across Ukraine's northern border. The oldest evacuee was 94 years old, while the youngest was one, according to Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's human rights ombudsman. Most customers in the Dnipropetrovsk region had their connections restored by early evening, but more than 60,000 were still without power, the governor said. Zelensky said in a social media post that the intensity of Russian strikes has been "extremely high" over the past week, adding that Russia was "trying to take maximum advantage of the shortage of ballistic missile interceptors". He thanked countries for their support so far and longer-term commitments, but called again for more immediate aid. ### Proposal on Russian Refinery Attacks and US Missiles

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that Ukraine is prepared to halt its strategic military strikes on Russian oil refineries on the condition that the United States provides long-range missile systems. Over recent months, Ukrainian long-range drone attacks have frequently targeted crude oil processing facilities inside Russia to weaken military fuel logistics and diminish Russian state energy revenues.

### Strategic Context and Key Details

- **Targeting Energy Assets:** Ukraine's attack strategy has focused on disrupting Russia's petroleum refining capacity, aiming to strain logistical support for military forces and reduce export income.
- **Conditionality on US Assistance:** President Zelensky's statement ties the suspension of these targeted operations directly to the procurement of long-range missile systems from the US military.
- **Defense Assistance Diplomacy:** The proposal underscores the diplomatic effort by Kyiv to negotiate crucial long-range defense supplies, which Ukraine considers vital for frontline deterrence and strategic strikes.

- **रक्षा सहायता कूटनीति:** यह प्रस्ताव कीव द्वारा लंबी दूरी की रक्षा आपूर्ति हासिल करने के कूटनीतिक प्रयासों को रेखांकित करता है।

news.headline: Expert Warns of Inflation Risks Amid Disparity Between Bank Credit Growth and GDP Growth, Urges RBI Intervention

news.full_article_text:
### Disparity Between Bank Credit and GDP Growth

A notable economic warning has been issued highlighting a growing imbalance between bank credit expansion and overall economic growth in India. Data indicates that bank credit growth has reached 19%, significantly outpacing the nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth rate of 10%.

### Inflation Risks vs Rupee Depreciation

Addressing the implications of this monetary gap, an economics professor emphasized that the primary concern arising from rapid credit expansion is elevated domestic inflation rather than exchange rate fluctuations or rupee risk. Unregulated or excessive credit growth can stimulate demand beyond supply capacities, leading to inflationary pressures in the economy.

### Recommendation for RBI Action

To mitigate potential macroeconomic instability and control persistent inflationary risks, the expert urged the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to intervene and rein in bank credit growth. Calibrating credit flow is seen as critical for balancing economic expansion with price stability.
bullet_points: Bank credit growth in India has reached 19%, compared to nominal GDP growth of 10%.
An economics professor highlighted that excess credit expansion poses a greater threat to domestic inflation than to rupee stability.
The expert called upon the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to rein in rapid bank credit expansion.
A significant gap between credit growth and GDP growth can fuel price rise by boosting aggregate demand beyond output capacity.
Monetary intervention by the central bank is advised to ensure price stability.

Nominal GDP growth rate: 10%
Primary risk flagged: Domestic inflation over rupee depreciation
Regulatory body urged to take action: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

impacts: Increased risk of domestic demand-driven inflation.

hindi_translation.story_lead: एक अर्थशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर ने घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति के खतरों को मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन से अधिक गंभीर बताते हुए ध्यान आकर्षित किया है। आंकड़े दर्शाते हैं कि बैंक ऋण वृद्धि 19% है जबकि नाममात्र जीडीपी वृद्धि 10% है। विशेषज्ञ ने भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) से बैंक ऋण वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने का आग्रह किया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### बैंक ऋण और जीडीपी वृद्धि के बीच विषमता

भारत में बैंक ऋण विस्तार और समग्र आर्थिक वृद्धि के बीच बढ़ते असंतुलन को रेखांकित करते हुए एक महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक चेतावनी जारी की गई है। आंकड़ों से पता चलता है कि बैंक ऋण वृद्धि 19% तक पहुंच गई है, जो कि 10% की नाममात्र सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (जीडीपी) वृद्धि दर से काफी अधिक है।

### मुद्रास्फीति का जोखिम बनाम रुपये का अवमूल्यन

इस मौद्रिक अंतर के निहितार्थों पर चर्चा करते हुए, अर्थशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर ने जोर देकर कहा कि तीव्र ऋण विस्तार से उत्पन्न होने वाली प्राथमिक चिंता विनिमय दर में उतार-चढ़ाव या रुपये के जोखिम के बजाय उच्च घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति है। अनियंत्रित या अत्यधिक ऋण वृद्धि आपूर्ति क्षमताओं से परे मांग को बढ़ावा दे सकती है, जिससे अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रास्फीति का दबाव बनता है।

### आरबीआई कार्रवाई की सिफारिश

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has accomplished the first orbit-raising manoeuvre for the NVS-03 navigation satellite. Following the planned propulsion burn, ground controllers confirmed that the satellite's health parameters and subsystems are in normal condition.

* **Mission Event**: Execution of the first orbit-raising operation following satellite insertion.
* **Spacecraft Status**: All parameters and onboard systems of NVS-03 are healthy and operating as expected.
* **Role of NVS Series**: The NVS series consists of next-generation satellites designed to sustain and enhance regional positioning, navigation, and timing services.

### इसरो का NVS-03 कक्षा संवर्धन ऑपरेशन

भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने NVS-03 नेविगेशन उपग्रह की कक्षा को ऊपर उठाने का पहला पैंतरा (Orbit-Raising Manoeuvre) सफलतापूर्वक पूरा किया है। निर्धारित थ्रस्टर बर्न के बाद, ग्राउंड कंट्रोलर्स ने पुष्टि की कि उपग्रह के स्वास्थ्य मानक और सभी उप-प्रणालियां सामान्य रूप से कार्य कर रही हैं।

* **मिशन घटना**: प्रक्षेपण के बाद उपग्रह की कक्षा को ऊपर उठाने के प्रथम चरण का निष्पादन।
* **अंतरिक्ष यान स्थिति**: NVS-03 के सभी पैरामीटर और ऑनबोर्ड सिस्टम स्वस्थ और अपेक्षा के अनुरूप कार्यरत हैं।
* **NVS श्रृंखला की भूमिका**: NVS श्रृंखला अगली पीढ़ी के उपग्रहों का समूह है जो क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन, स्थिति निर्धारण और समय सेवाओं को मजबूत करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है।
